title: Move from iPhone.
Continue on Android.
i2a.description: Open TransGuru on Android and connect the iPhone with a data cable. Follow the guide to back up and convert your data, then restore your chats in WhatsApp.
overview: Connect the cable and trust the Android device on your iPhone.
Check the backup settings and select the account to move.
Follow the guide to install WhatsApp and restore the backup.
requirements: An Android phone that supports USB OTG
A cable that supports data transfer
An unlocked iPhone and enough battery on both phones
i2a.caution: Before you restore, back up any chats that you need to keep on the destination phone. Migration does not merge chats.
steps: Connect
Connect the cable and trust the Android device on your iPhone
Check the backup
Follow the guide to check encrypted backup and Find My settings
Back up
Back up and read your chat data
Prepare to restore
Select an account, preview the data, and confirm replacement
Uninstall
Follow the guide to uninstall WhatsApp from the destination phone
Convert
Create a backup that Android can restore
Reinstall
Reinstall WhatsApp from an official source
Restore
Follow the WhatsApp restore guide and verify your data
checklist: Android 7.0 or later with USB OTG support
A data cable that fits both phones
A separate backup of any chats to keep on the destination phone
Enough battery and free storage on both phones

title: Move from Android.
Continue on iPhone.
a2i.description: Create an encrypted backup on Android and enter its key when prompted. TransGuru converts the data and transfers it to the iPhone through a data cable.
overview: Follow the guide to create a backup and save its encryption key.
Process the backup on the Android phone and prepare it for iPhone.
Check the iPhone, transfer the data, then verify your chats.
requirements: The source Android phone and destination iPhone
The correct 64-character encryption key for the current backup
An Android phone with USB OTG support and a compatible data cable
a2i.caution: This route replaces the WhatsApp data on the iPhone. It cannot merge the backup with existing chats. Save a separate copy of important data first.
steps: Back up on Android
Create an encrypted backup and select an account
Enter the key
Enter and verify the backup encryption key
Decrypt and convert
Process and prepare the data on Android
Prepare to transfer
Follow the guide to sign in and check settings on the iPhone
Connect
Connect both phones with a data cable
Run final checks
Check that the iPhone is ready
Transfer
Keep the phones connected, then verify chats and media
checklist: Android 7.0 or later with USB OTG support
The correct 64-character encryption key for the current backup
A separate copy of important WhatsApp data on the iPhone, with the understanding that restore replaces it
A data cable, enough battery, and enough free storage

title: Move from Android.
Keep what matters.
a2a.description: Open TransGuru and turn on Wi-Fi on both phones, then choose the old and new phone. The app creates a local connection so you can scan and transfer the backup and media. If this connection is not available, connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi network.
overview: Choose the old and new phone
Find the chats on the old phone and prepare the new phone.
Show the code on the new phone, then scan it and send the data from the old phone.
Follow the guide to restore the backup in WhatsApp.
requirements: TransGuru installed on both Android phones
Wi-Fi enabled so the app can create a local connection, or both phones connected to the same Wi-Fi network
The backup encryption key saved if it is required for restore
a2a.caution: Keep the original backup before you start, and verify chats and media after restore.
steps: Choose each phone
Select New phone on one device and Old phone on the other
Prepare
Find the backup on the old phone and prepare the new phone
Install and enter the key
Reinstall WhatsApp on the new phone and provide the key from the old phone when required
Scan
Show the QR code on the new phone and scan it with the old phone
Transfer
Keep the local connection active while the backup and media are sent
Restore
Restore in WhatsApp on the new phone and verify your data
checklist: Android 7.0 or later and USB OTG support on both phones
Wi-Fi enabled on both phones, without manually enabling a shared system hotspot
The original backup and any required encryption key are saved
I will verify important chats and media on the new phone after restore
